[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/e4a8f422f8efdc79c260b1bde20a84e34eb0d351.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce the release of [b]Patch 6[/b] for [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], packed with fixes and improvements to enhance your renovation experience. Here's a rundown of what's been addressed.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] We've restored the missing visual effect for surface destruction, making your renovation efforts more satisfying than ever.
[*] We've fixed the issue that prevented the removal of paint from panels after panel destruction. Now you can renovate with precision and without any lingering paint woes.
[*] No more overlapping text! We've cleaned up the UI in the "Mods made by You" screen, ensuring a seamless modding experience.
[*] Long category names are no longer a problem! We've adjusted the in-game frame to accommodate those lengthy category names when creating mods.
[*] Renovate your disco floors with ease! We've improved renovation performance by enhancing the flooring division.
[*] No more delays in unlocking Floor 2! We've resolved the issue, ensuring a smooth progression experience.
[*] Say goodbye to texture delays! We've optimized the loading of textures for player-affected surfaces, enhancing overall performance.
[*] We've fixed the issue causing simultaneous tips to appear on unrenovated additional floors, providing clearer guidance during renovations.
[*] Enjoy precise wall decoration placement on the third floor! Minimalist Wall Panel 3 and Deco Wall Panel 3 can no longer be placed separately from the wall.
[*] NPC heads are now solid! We've eliminated the issue of seeing through NPC heads for a more immersive experience.
[*] Objects will stay where they belong! We've prevented objects from being placed outside the hotel boundaries.
[*] Renovate without performance hiccups! FPS drops after placing multiple cleaning robots have been addressed.
[*] Stay informed about your mods! We've added warnings to alert you when installed mods become unavailable.
[/list]
Get ready to dive back into the world of [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] with [b]Patch 6[/b], and experience smoother, more polished renovations than ever before.

[b]Hello, Renovators![/b]

Are your guests complaining about the lack of amenities? It’s time to change that! The latest [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] DLC finally introduces something for the muscles instead of the brains.

With the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1214470/Hotel_Renovator/]Gym Furniture Set[/url][/b] DLC for [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], you can transform the additional room on the 2nd floor into a state-of-the-art fitness centre. After all, every premium hotel needs a workout space – even if some guests never bother to use it.

But not all guests are like the hero of our latest short video. He’s truly dedicated to the art of muscle-building but may lack a bit in the gym etiquette department. Watch the ad and make sure you never repeat his mistake.

[previewyoutube=KFlVuZHUEDk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Gym Furniture Set DLC[/b] is available today! Get it now and provide your guests with a fitness facility they'll never want to leave!

[h3]Apart from the DLC, we are also introducing Patch 5 which takes care of the following issues:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a number of incorrectly used rendering features (like hardware tessellation) in NPCs' materials - was causing the materials to either glitch out or just straight up crash the graphics driver on some older GPUs.
[*] Fixed a rare crash caused by some corrupted texture imports in one of the lobby decorations.
[*] Fixed a couple situations in which loading into a savefile while a popup (event message, interaction prompt) was meant to appear right at the save point would cause the player to be blocked from moving and the game time would be frozen.
[*] Fixed an issue where room flooding from the Cracked Pipe event experienced in one game would transfer to subsequently opened save files
[*] Fixed a rare case in which the Engagement Ring would not spawn correctly in the swimming pool after the patio renovation event is over, blocking player progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Make your hotel profitable
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/e8a149c46739aa0dda3937e6ac3359b53c25aa05.png[/img]

The economy of running a hotel is a complicated and layered task, but in [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], it’s pretty easy to grasp. To be successful, a hotel needs to be profitable and provide high-quality services to the guests. All that while maintaining a positive reputation to attract more and more guests. In [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], we captured the essence of running a hotel by considering several economic factors without overly complicated bookkeeping.

The critical factor is obviously the [b]income[/b] generated through the sale of accessible rooms. Room prices will vary depending on the quality of the finishing and furnishing, and the rate at which you sell available rooms will significantly impact your income. Rooms with a higher rating can be sold at a higher rate, but not all guests are willing to pay more for their stay. That means you must maintain a healthy balance to attract guests of all wallet sizes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/26da22cb0762e5694416f1880365a29e947e5e2b.gif[/img]

[b]Expenses[/b] are as equally important as income. A successful business will only keep afloat if the income is higher than the cost of operation. With every new room, your water and energy expenses will increase, so you need to be sure that the occupancy of the hotel is high enough to cover them. The best way to save money is to do most of the repairs and cleaning yourself, but once your hotel grows in size, you will be tempted to hire room service staff and a handyman.

Providing a high level of [b]customer service[/b] is essential for a hotel to attract and retain guests. Some factors contributing to customer satisfaction include the cleanliness of rooms and common areas, and the availability of amenities such as a swimming pool, a cafe and a restaurant. Finishing the rooms according to your guests' [b]Style Suggestions[/b] will also impact satisfaction and grant extra bonuses. Customers may be more satisfied with their stay if their room is neighbouring one occupied by a VIP, but on the other hand, a noisy or dirty neighbour might be a cause of concern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/2cfd939fc4f9e33d5523e68f799f55e04e4e14b9.png[/img]

Last but not least is the hotel’s [b]reputation[/b]. Just as in real life, reputation can significantly impact its ability to attract new guests. If you maintain an efficiently run and clean hotel with access to attractive amenities, your hotel will get a higher ranking. With each awarded star, you will unlock more and more features and items to make your hotel even more popular. Keeping a high standard of your rooms and taking good care of your guests will increase its reputation and allow you to get more income.  

[b]TLDR:[/b] The economy of [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] involves balancing the need to generate income with the need to control expenses while also providing high levels of customer service and maintaining a positive reputation. Are you up to the task?

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/e11460a26ff75da5d6b386150cd36c545c3b3e27.png[/img]

Interior arrangements in Scandinavian style are simple, well-thought-out, and functional. They are dominated by the simplicity of form and almost non-existent details. Light colors are the perfect base here.

It's best to start decorating by choosing the color of the walls and floors. White, milk or ecru wall colors will perfectly match light brown or white floors. If you want your interior to be cozy, it’s a good idea to add a small fluffy rug to it.

One of the characteristic features of this style is love for nature, which is reflected by the organic forms of furniture and decorative objects.

Must-have 1: Scandinavian rug that matches the interior 
Must-have 2: Wood, rattan, and lots of plants
Must-have 3: A plush sofa, armchair, or a pouf 
Must-have 4: Minimalism in decorations, pillows, blankets
Must-have 5: Indirect light source, like a small wall lamp

Some other popular addons are fabrics with patterns and smoked glass porcelain.

The amount of lighting in a room can significantly affect its appearance and usability. Lights should be selected due to their usability and the function they perform. 

How can you properly illuminate a room?

Artificial light is an imitation of natural light, which is the sunlight. There should be three types of lights in every room:

[list]
[*] [b]The leading light[/b] - takes the central place in the room. Its task is to illuminate the room evenly. The lamp should be selected according to the room size. It would be, for example, a large chandelier or a slender pendant lamp.

[*] [b]Task light[/b] - is the light that we use when performing a specific activity. It is, for example, a standing desk lamp, a table lamp, or a wall lamp. It should have adjustable stands.

[*] [b]Decorative light[/b] - is an additional light that serves only as a decorative element and gives a subtle touch of illumination.  It could be a crystal wall lamp or other small, designer lights.
[/list]

Thanks to the lighting, you can create exciting interiors that will attract the eyes and delight your visitors. For a long time, it has been known that the combination of plants and light gives an exciting result in shadow play.

[b]How to influence the room's appearance?[/b]

Lighting directed at the ceiling optically enlarges the room. The light illuminating the floor gives the impression of a lower and darker interior. Darkening the lower zones of the walls enlarges the space visually. Lighting a room with wall lamps makes the interior seem smaller.

[b]Light color temperature[/b]

Each room requires the correct color of light. Choosing a warm or cool color has a functional significance and affects our mood and well-being.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/c58d0ec999617bfc836c662ec177e61e57b1c96e.png[/img]

Warm lighting affects our minds to feel more relaxed and at ease. But a cool lighting turns into a blue and is best for everyday work.

The oriental style of lighting is much different from the European one. It often uses the Moroccan-style lamps and lanterns made out of metal or gourds or light paper lamps from the Far East.

The colors of the oriental style are intense. It is primarily red, which symbolizes happiness in Chinese culture. Saturated shades of green and yellow and the color of dark wood are also welcome here.

The oriental arrangement wouldn’t be complete without specific fabrics. Pillows or curtains can be shiny, decorated with traditional patterns. Carpets should also appear in the designs.

If you plan to design an apartment in an oriental style, you have many arrangement possibilities. Choose oriental furniture and items carefully, guided primarily by their quality - be inspired, but do not copy, avoid literalism by looking at current trends.

notes.title: Designer’s Corner #4 - How to arrange the corridor?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/9a537240d14953f34c658b31482c27326d5d4638.png[/img]

The corridor is our showcase. It’s the first room we see when we enter our house or other places, so we need to focus on the functionality of this room and, of course, on the furniture. It is worth bringing decorations and accessories to the front.

The key to success in finishing any interior design is consistency. A small room will visually gain a few centimeters if we focus on light colors (beige, gray, white, etc.).

A bright corridor doesn't have to be boring. You can break the monotony by painting one wall in a darker color. Brick walls or properly selected wall decorations can also be a nice change.

[b]Some of the most commonly used in wall decorations:[/b]

[list]
[*] brick or stone
[*] wall cladding
[*] wall panel
[*] decorative wallpaper
[*] mural
[*] decorative plasters
[/list]

[b]For the floor, the most commonly used are:[/b]

[list]
[*] wooden parquet
[*] laminate panels
[*] porcelain tiles
[*] resin
[*] stone
[*] PVC floor coverings
[/list]

[b]How would you decorate the corridor walls?[/b]

Use mirrors, as they optically enlarge space and work great when paired with paintings and wall lamps, illuminated strips, or even bookshelves. To finish it off, a table with a flower vase and a fluffy rug will beautifully warm the corridor interior.

The [b]Classic Style [/b]is characterized by warm colors and matching furniture arrangements. The most important features of this style are simplicity and class. In modern times, classic style is often associated with minimalism and top-shelf accessories. It’s often defined as the [b]English style.[/b] The main pillars here are simplicity, balance, and symmetry.

[h3]Characteristic colors:[/h3]

[*] gray

The design can be finished with [b]stuccos on the ceiling, moldings, and cornices.[/b]

[b]Consistency[/b] is an essential aspect of the Classic Style. The whole interior should be held together by a characteristic element, such as the color of furniture or fabrics.

The classic style looks best when used in [b]large spaces[/b], with wooden windows, elegant lamps, and high-quality furniture. It’s a [b]posh style[/b] suitable for classy people.

notes.title: Designer’s Corner #2 - Halloween Gothic
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/dceb1ff2b2c25be560fab0e9769627c256675514.png[/img]

[h3]Gothic Style[/h3] 
One of the most unusual interior design styles. It reflects an atmosphere of luxury and personality and it’s characterized by dark colors of walls, floors, and ceilings. Gothic Style is easily recognized by decorative patterns and materials, such as ornamented wood, forged metal or stained glass. 
[b]
Here are some features of the Gothic style:[/b]

[list]
[*] Dark shades of colors are used for dramatic effect, for example, burgundy, navy blue, dark brown, or black.
[*] The furniture usually has dark upholstery, and the accessories are most of the time contrasting it, for example in red or purple, and even white colors.
[*] Several different materials are usually used for the floors, such as tiles with white patterns, carpets or pure white wood.
[*] Fancy wallpapers are very fitting, especially ones with ornament patterns
[*] It’s good to experiment with lighting. Using elegant chandeliers and wall lamps creates the perfect atmosphere.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/ef0e9bb303ea8edb83ef27acd1f5afa330b47b27.png[/img]

Gothic is often associated with a spooky look. Black castles, vampires, ghosts, graveyards - the theme is a scary one. Let’s take advantage of the Halloween season and create a climatic [b]Hotel Renovator [/b]demo interior!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/f00e04ef6e8ae0e4c197d608ae2f7620c2a92094.png[/img]

Fairy tale look, with noble knights, generous kings, and beautiful princesses is difficult to recreate without elegant armchairs, solid carved chests, and painted canopies over the beds. Beautiful and expensive semi-antique furniture is an indispensable element of a gothic interior.

Good luck with your projects! I’m waiting for your design screenshots on our Discord channel. See you in the next one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/de2684689ee3151abcc120289b377b9706609f0d.png[/img]

So, you’ve inherited an old hotel after your grandpa passed away some time ago. You finally find the time to go and inspect the object, that for years wasn’t used for its purpose. You walk through the rusty doors, and the first thing you notice is a [b]chicken running around the lobby[/b]. The first thing that comes to your mind is, of course, a censorable expression, but let’s be fair, it is pretty shocking. The Hotel Renovator demo doesn’t explain how and why the not-so-angry bird found its way in, but there must be a reason behind it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1214470/Hotel_Renovator/
Suddenly, you hear your assistant [b]Sandra [/b]telling you to “get rid of the hen” by throwing her out of the window. And you know what? You do it! You throw the poor thing out, even though it was there before you, and who knows what this bird’s story is. Fortunately, the chicken lands on the outside pavement without any harm, and you go on and perform your first real task of [b]smashing everything around you with a crowbar.[/b]

But the chicken and its story are still in on the back of your head.  All the how’s and all the why’s. Hopefully, you will get your answers when the full Hotel Renovator game comes out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/a0a659324d2b1805bdfaff60746d977c917f8c12.png[/img]


Like in most simulator games, the economy will play a major part in our game. 
It will depend on how much money you can invest in the quality of life improvements, extra accessories, higher quality furniture and expansion of your hotel. 

Flipping your money and investing it wisely will profit in no time, but you will have to balance between the needs of your guests and common sense - you know, some people are just needing the stuff to need the stuff even when they don’t need the stuff. 
So here you are, responsible manager, renovator and designer. Will you fulfil all the whims of your customers to make them happy? Or will you just sell overpriced rooms just to earn quick cash?

notes.title: Devlog: The Play Of Lights
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/526d172f70e84e30a65edc54e8d56f54d37066f2.png[/img]

The large majority of our impressions of the world come through our eyes. That’s why good light and lighting setup is very important. Light is like the medium through which a majority of us perceive the world.


There are a lot of different ways to achieve perfect order and harmony. Lighting, accessories, furniture and even a small carpet decorating your floor need to work together to make this wow effect. With a few design ideas, multiple ways of customization and perfect lighting you'll be able to find that sweet spot in every part of your hotel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/1d1c09dc19a5145eb6353af8122968861ac7f6f2.png[/img]

Different shapes, different styles and colours of lighting won’t have a huge impact on the economic part of the game but they’ll for sure make THE impression.
Curves, geometric shapes or even simple spheres will add that extra flavour and hypnotise you and your friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1214470

To find a sweet spot, you’ll have to balance and adapt interiors so each part of your project would match and complement. Choosing a few high-quality accessories and furniture is one of the ways, but how about the minimalist room with a beautiful light play? Your hotel, your choice! Experiment with all the assets to achieve perfection.

[b]Let’s light this corner up with our 3rd Vlog![/b]

Lighting is like a special ingredient that spices up the interior or transforms it completely into something else. That’s why it was essential for us to let you play with it on many levels - not only in the form of a bed lamp or fancy chandelier in the lobby. We also wanted to bring more than one type of light because most of the designers would agree that lighting in a room should take many forms/come in different forms.
Creating amazing interiors and games that will please the eye of the gamers wouldn’t be possible without Dynamic Lighting and other cool effects that we’re implementing in the game. We’ll talk about them at the upcoming special event with our Developers ;)
